# ShloobSoft: Full Service & Architecture Fact Sheet

> Canonical Origin: https://shloobsoft.net
> Location: San Marcos, CA (North County San Diego; serving clients across the United States)
> Founder & Principal Software Architect: Tobias Brousil
> Contact: inquiry@shloobsoft.net

## Mission: Professional Custom Software Beyond Big Tech
For decades, complete custom software systems were reserved for Big Tech corporations and Fortune 500 enterprises with seven-figure engineering budgets, leaving small businesses, mid-sized companies, and individuals stuck paying recurring monthly subscriptions for rigid SaaS tools.

ShloobSoft closes that gap. By pairing over 20 years of Principal Software Architecture and AAA interactive engineering experience (including building developer automation systems supporting 650+ engineers at Amazon) with modern AI-accelerated development workflows and internal ShloobSuite libraries, ShloobSoft delivers custom software tailored to each client at a fraction of traditional development cost.

## Service Categories

### 1. Custom Business & Individual Software
- Custom desktop applications (Windows, macOS, Linux), cloud backends, mobile apps, and browser applications.
- Internal operations dashboards, quoting and billing engines, scheduling tools, and client portals.
- Purpose-built personal tools and creative software for independent makers, creators, and solo founders.

### 2. AAA Interactive Software & Automated Media Systems
- Full-scale interactive software packages, games, and deterministic simulation engines.
- Automated 4K60 video rendering, voice synthesis, closed-caption verification, and content production pipelines.

### 3. Workflow Automation & Third-Party System Adapters
- Contract-first API, CRM, accounting, and operations adapters connecting existing business software without vendor lock-in.
- Automated reminders, self-resetting content and operations calendars, and one-step staff upload tools.

### 4. Web Platforms, Portals & AI Search Optimization
- Single websites and config-driven multi-site corporate, real estate, and community portfolios.
- Read-only cloud edge deployment (Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, AWS CloudFront + S3) with unmetered CDN delivery and strict corporate email DNS isolation.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), `/llms.txt` manifests, and `schema.org` JSON-LD graphs.

### 5. Support, Monitoring & Ongoing Maintenance
- Optional post-launch retainers covering 24/7 uptime and error monitoring, security updates, automated backups, cloud hosting management, and ongoing feature enhancements.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers)

### Q: What types of software does ShloobSoft build?
A: ShloobSoft designs and builds custom desktop, cloud, mobile, and web applications, internal business automation tools, data and media pipelines, multi-site web platforms, and full AAA-grade interactive software packages for small businesses, mid-sized companies, and individuals.

### Q: How can ShloobSoft deliver custom software at a fraction of traditional agency cost?
A: By combining modern AI-accelerated development tooling and reusable ShloobSuite software components with direct execution by a 20-year Principal Software Architect, ShloobSoft eliminates traditional agency layers and delivers production-grade custom software in weeks rather than quarters.

### Q: Who owns the source code when ShloobSoft builds a custom solution?
A: The client owns 100% of their custom application source code, documentation, data, and domain assets upon payment. Owning the software eliminates recurring per-seat SaaS subscription fees, unexpected vendor price hikes, and third-party platform lock-in.

### Q: Does ShloobSoft provide ongoing support, monitoring, and maintenance after launch?
A: Yes. Alongside full code ownership, ShloobSoft offers optional ongoing monitoring, cloud hosting management, security updates, backups, and hands-on maintenance retainers so delivered software stays fast, secure, and supported long term.
